name: Cold Cave
description:
'''Cold Cave''' is the solo [[electronic music]] project of musician [[Wesley Eisold]]. Founded in 2007, Cold Cave has issued three studio albums and seven EPs, among other releases. Contributors to the project have included [[Caralee McElroy]], [[Dominick Fernow]], and [[Jennifer Clavin]].

Cold Cave has [[Opening act|support]]ed acts such as [[Gary Numan]], [[Nine Inch Nails]], and [[The Jesus and Mary Chain]].
